name: Sun-Life Holding Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sun-Life Holding Co.,Ltd. is a Japanese company serving life events and elder care. It runs hotels and ceremonial venues, arranges funerals, and manages nursing homes and senior residences. It also offers pet funeral support, commemorative children's photography, cleaning, embalming and cremation urn sales. Founded in 1933, it is headquartered in Hiratsuka.
